title: Circle Z

services.name: Horseback Rides
services.desc: Our all-day rides are typically offered on Thursdays, and these are very popular excursions for our more adventurous guests. In the mornings, our cooks create a custom sack lunch for you, which you will pack, along with your water, into your saddle horn bags and off you go! These are 5-hour rides that take you exploring onto 3 different trails that we are only able to do for the all-day rides. Ventura Ridge offers guests the chance to explore the grasslands and canyons to the south of the Circle Z and to have lunch on a vista overlooking the ranch lands and into Mexico. The terrain is steep in areas, so we like folks to have experienced a few days in the saddle before this ride. Castle
